`ltim_ye_dec2025.xlsx` is the **genuine** ONS workbook "Long-term international migration, provisional:
year ending December 2025" (`may2026publicationspreadsheet.xlsx`), fetched unchanged on a GitHub runner on
2026-11-09. Used to test the `ons_ltim` parser offline. Never published from here; published data come from
`make refresh` and live under `data/raw/`. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0.
